machineIdentity.credentialAcceptedEvidence: Bounded and exact: the run's stdout did NOT contain `PROMOTION_IDENTITY_LIVE_ACCEPTANCE=BLOCKED_EXTERNAL`. That status is emitted by blockedExternal() from exactly two credential guards — line 128 `if (!runtime.configured)` and line 141 the selfCheck guard. Neither fired. Therefore `runtime.configured` was true and the installed identity loaded from the vault. This proves the credential was READ and the identity was CONFIGURED. It does NOT prove that authentication or installation reachability were verified, because the failure occurred afterwards at createCandidateWorkspace (line 187) and the earlier selfCheck result was never printed. Authentication health is itself part of what the aborted preflight would have reported.

preflight.actual: PROMOTION_IDENTITY_LIVE_ACCEPTANCE=FAIL RuntimeIsolationError: candidate runtime tree overlaps Stable surfaces: <candidate root inside stable root>

rootCause.preciseCause: The acceptance derives its Candidate evolution root from the checkout it runs in, which places the Candidate INSIDE the Stable root; the isolation invariant correctly refuses that configuration.
evidenceChain: live-promotion-acceptance.ts:187 — `createCandidateWorkspace({ stableRoot: process.cwd(), evolutionRoot, baseSha, runId, allowNonHeadBase: true })`
runtime-isolation.ts:180 — `if (isInside(stableRoot, layout.root)) overlaps.push("<candidate root inside stable root>");`
rootCause.whyItFails: runtime-isolation.ts:180 exists to enforce §8.3 (the Candidate must be isolated from Stable). Running the acceptance in development mode makes Stable = the checkout itself and derives Candidate = <checkout>/runtime-data/evolution/<runId>, so the invariant is unconditionally violated. The check is correct; the acceptance's own environment cannot satisfy the invariant it verifies.
rootCause.significance: This is the same class of defect as OBS-GOV-001: the mechanism that exists to enforce an invariant cannot, in the configuration it is actually run in, satisfy it. Here it failed CLOSED (loud refusal), which is the safe direction — the opposite of OBS-GOV-001's silent success.

workaroundConsideredAndRejected.idea: Place the evolution root outside the checkout, or run the acceptance from a non-repo directory.
whyRejected: `stableRoot: process.cwd()` requires the working directory to be the repository, and `createCandidateWorkspace` refuses a root without .git (workspace-manager.ts:105-108).

Relocating the evolution root, or setting stableRoot separately from the data root, is a change to the PF020 acceptance source to make the test pass — explicitly forbidden by this round's instruction.

remoteMutationCheck.conclusion: The preflight failed before any push or PR. Nothing was mutated remotely. No acceptance PR exists, so there was nothing to approve, merge or close.
